Title: Excel Tech pack
Transcripts: hi everyone in this video i will show you how to generate an excel tech pack from a closet style page all the work done in chloe can be generated into an excel tech pack by a closet to do this select tech pack from the individual file drop down menu the tech pack will then download simply left click on the downloaded file in order to open the tech pack is an excel file format therefore completely editable once the tab pack has opened you will notice there are several pages within the tech pack the first page of the editable tech pack consists of a garment overview with the 3d images of the front back and side views alongside the styles information the second page is the cut as must with a list of all the pattern pieces that are used within the project the third page is the colorway with a bom of the garment the bom includes fabric print layout graphics and trims such as buttons zippers and obj trims each colorway will get its own page and own vom information given in the colorway mode or the bom editor mode in clone such as price and units will also be generated within this excel tech pack the penultimate page is graphic the image and the placement of each graphic is listed here the final page of the tech pack is for measurement this includes the pom and graded information for the style you

Title: 3D Tech pack
Transcripts: hi everyone in this video you will learn how to use the 3d tech pack within a style page to access a 3d tech pack select the 3d tech pack icon that can be found on the top left corner of your interactive viewer from here a drop down menu will appear of your 3d tech pack the first menu consists of patterns by left clicking on a pattern name you will see the matching pattern piece in 3d to preview multiple pattern pieces in 3d hold down ctrl and then left click to select multiple items you can also select the pattern icon on the right hand side of the menu to preview your patterns in their 2d layouts the second option within the 3d tech pack is for fabric by selecting fabric you will get a list of the fabrics used within this style the third menu is for trims here you will see a list of all the trims used within this style by clicking on one of the trims from the list you will also get a preview of that trim in 3d you can also drag and move the 3d tech pack menu in order to see your 3d viewer clearer you can add an annotation to a specific component of a 3d tech pack to do this select a component of your 3d tech pack then select create annotation in the right corner of your interactive viewer use the different options from the annotation list such as text box and arrows to create your annotation select post in order to complete your text box annotation then select complete in order to finish the entire annotation use the back arrow to close your 3d tech pack window you will now see the 3d tech pack annotation has been added on the right hand side under annotation select the newly created annotation from the list in order to preview and edit the annotation

Title: Create Space
Transcripts: hi everyone in this video i will show you how to create your closet space starting at company all the way to workroom so let's begin start by selecting companies in the left side menu once you are in companies you can click to create a new company from here you can add a custom name and even a custom image then click to confirm with your company created simply left click on the icon to enter your company from here you can add a brand to the company by clicking on the plus icon from here you can choose a custom brand name and thumbnail as well and then click to confirm you will now see your brand enter your brand by clicking on the icon from here you can add a season by clicking on the hanger icon repeat the same process by choosing a custom name and then click to confirm you can now enter your season in here you will see your work room from here you can enter your work room by clicking on the icon within the workroom you will have access to all your different styles to upload a file simply click on the upload button from here you can choose your upload scenario you can choose either single or multiple files turntable images or blank styles then click next within here you can then choose to select directly from your computer or to drag and drop to upload the file you can also decide on your category choices for this style then click to upload once uploading is complete the file will appear in the workroom click on the garment to access the style page you will now have access to the style page to learn more about how to use the style page please watch the other videos if you would like to download this file you can do so by using the drop down menu for the style once the file is downloaded you can open the zprj or zpac file in closed software to make further changes
